node-compatibility:

      matrix:
        node-version: ["24.18.0", "26.10.0"]

      contents: read

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
      - name: Prove selected Node runtime
        env:
          EXPECTED_NODE_VERSION: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
        run: node -e "if (process.version !== 'v' + process.env.EXPECTED_NODE_VERSION) throw Error('Node runtime mismatch')"
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@008330803749db0355799c700092d9a85fd074e9 # v6.0.9
        with:
          version: 11.18.0
          run_install: false
      - name: Install isolated compatibility parser
        run: pnpm --dir scripts/node-compatibility-tooling install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts --ignore-pnpmfile --config.engine-strict=true --config.strict-peer-dependencies=true
      - name: Check bounded Node compatibility contract
        run: |

          node --test scripts/check-node-compatibility.test.mjs

- name: Prove selected Node runtime
